summary: PR-1615 is a trivial cosmetic refactoring of the required_approvals function in payments/payments.py, converting an if/else block to an equivalent ternary expression. The behaviour is identical: payments at or above the dual-control threshold still require two approvers, and smaller payments still require one. The change has a properly approved standard ticket, an independent code_review approval from a qualified change_approver on the exact head commit, and a clean CI run on the final commit with all 172 tests (including all relevant control tests) passing. No protected paths or security-sensitive components are touched, and no exception is needed. All applicable obligations are satisfied.
